CAG Report Highlights Financial Concerns in Maharashtra Schemes

A report by the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) has raised concerns regarding financial management within Maharashtra. The report specifically points to potential strain on state finances due to the Ladki Bahin scheme and exposes billions in hidden debt and parked funds within the state's shadow economy. These findings suggest potential fiscal challenges and lack of transparency in financial dealings.
